IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Wednesday 25 November
Winds: West to southwesterly below 10 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly clear.

Thursday 26 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming south to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming variable below 10 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 27 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning northeasterly in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Becoming cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Variable about 10 knots becoming southerly 15 to 20 knots during the day then tending southwesterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon or evening.
Weather: Cloudy. 95% chance of rain.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Southwesterly below 10 knots tending westerly 10 to 15 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high to the east of the state is expected to slowly move away, across the Tasman Sea, until the end of the week while maintaining a weak ridge over Tasmania. A trough over Victoria will extend over northwestern waters on Friday then move over Tasmania on Saturday morning, before moving away to the east. A cold front arrives during the day Sunday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Wednesday 25 November
Winds: South to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots near Tasman Island.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 26 November
Winds: Northwest to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots becoming variable about 10 knots in the early morning then becoming northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then decreasing to around 1 metre during the afternoon.
Weather: Cloud clearing.

Friday 27 November
Winds: North to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres by early evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny day. 70% chance of showers in the evening.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Northeasterly 15 to 25 knots shifting southwesterly during the morning.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 95% chance of rain.
